description.value: McDonald's at 160 Southwest Marine Drive is a drive-through fast-food restaurant on Vancouver's southwest side, serving burgers, chicken, breakfast items, and McCafé beverages. It is part of the McDonald's Canada chain and sits along Southwest Marine Drive, a route used by cyclists connecting Vancouver's south end. The location offers a familiar and accessible food stop for riders passing through the area.
